payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image clearly render its visual content as a pencil drawing?
node.criteria: Pass only when pencil-like linework and shading visibly render the depicted content as a drawing, rather than merely desaturating, adding grain, or softening photographic detail. Fail when the image is clearly not rendered in a pencil-drawn style. Unknown when the edited image is unavailable or the style cannot be determined.
node.binding: Assess whether the edited image completes the requested transformation from the supplied image into a pencil drawing. Content preservation, muted color, or grain alone does not establish completion.
